title: Custom Server Banners
description: Add custom static and animated banners to any server in Minecraft's multiplayer server list.
body:
# Server Banner

Customize any server in Minecraft's multiplayer list with your own banners.

Server Banner allows you to assign custom images to any server entry, making your server list more personal, organized, and visually appealing.

## Features

- Add custom banners to any server.
- Supports static and animated banners.
- Animation is powered by sprite atlases.
- Multiple scaling modes for improved animation quality and detail.
- Works entirely on the client.
- No server-side installation required.
- Compatible with any Minecraft server.

## How It Works

Select a server in your multiplayer list and assign a custom banner image. If the image is a sprite atlas, Server Banner can automatically play it as an animation.

The banner is displayed directly in the server list, allowing you to create unique server entries with custom artwork, branding, or animated effects.

## Client-Side Only

This mod is completely client-side.

Servers do not need to install anything, and the banners are only visible to players who have Server Banner installed.

## Supported Formats

- PNG images
- Sprite atlas animations
- Multiple animation scale options

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3
